days.mission_in: Notice one sound that changes as you walk.
days.entry: Dad went to the market road. The vegetable sellers were speaking loudly. As we went further, the sound of the temple bell started to come. There was a gulmohar near the paan shop, and there were crows on it.
Dad bought some guavas from the cart near the paan shop today. The crows were on the gulmohar again. There were a lot of scooters parked everywhere.

days.entry: Dad walked only till the paan shop and came back. It rained in the afternoon, and the road was muddy. The gulmohar had dropped a lot of leaves.

days.entry: Dad was at the market today. A band baja wala was going, and it was someone's wedding. There were many people behind each other.
